incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=runtime-proxy latency_p95 > 1200ms in us-east-1 · PagerDuty incident id: PDR123456
ops-bot: automated check: 10 unique hosts reporting high p95, autoscaler healthy, no CPU anomalies
alex: ack
maria: ack
alex: any customer-facing errors? logs?
maria: quick grep, no 5xx spike in frontend, only increased tail latency logs from proxy
zach: looks like KV warmup spikes hitting proxies, seeing many warm_start cache_miss events
lina: tagging in runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-warmup
ops-bot: silenced PagerDuty rule "proxy-high-latency" for 15m by alex
alex: silenced; will monitor. adding suppress on synthetic canary so it doesn't churn PD
maria: watch metrics: p95 latency down from 1400 -> 900 in last 60s
zach: running quick rolling restart of proxy pool shard eu-west-1? actually this is us-east-1, will avoid cross-region
alex: don't restart yet; prefer to increase pool size and let warm caches fill
lina: increased proxy pool by +3 instances (k8s scale deployment/proxy -n prod --replicas=12)
ops-bot: k8s scale started, pods launching: proxy-12d8b, proxy-12d8c, proxy-12d8d
maria: p95 now 720ms and trending down, canary checks green
alex: good. I'll handoff to @next-oncall in 10m after we confirm stable for 5m
next-oncall: received. please leave any outstanding TODOs
alex: TODOs: follow up with infra to add KV prefill during scale events; file PR to alerting to add aggregation window 2m and require >=3 hosts before PD
zach: capturing logs & graphs: https://observability/links/graph/abc123
lina: adding post-incident note to runbook and filing followup ticket: INFRA-4321
maria: un-silencing PD at 15m mark if metrics stable
ops-bot: PagerDuty silence expires in 14m
incidentbot: alert auto-resolved (PagerDuty PDR123456) — note: transient warmup spike, no customer 5xx impact
alex: closing thread, handoff complete :thumbsup:
next-oncall: thanks, will keep an eye for next hour
maria: followup: can we add a suppression rule for KV-prefill spikes to avoid noise? filing TICKET-998
zach: will draft alert tuning PR
lina: noted, will include steps in runbook
ops-bot: deploybot: last deploy for proxy service was 2026-03-14T23:12:03Z
maria: OK — all good, resolving local monitoring alert
